1. Concept Overview الفكرة العامة

HAJWALA: Saudi Drift & Highway Legends is a next-generation 3D driving & drifting simulation celebrating Saudi car culture: Hajwala (هجولة), highway cruising, Khabaat (خبات), Ta'tees (تطعيس بين السيارات), and airport Mataar (مطار) drift meets. Players master weight-transfer drifting, top-speed highway runs, and near-traffic threading — then show off tuned builds in the Garage.

Design pillars

  • Authenticity (أصالة): real Saudi line-up, Arabic plates, tinting (تظليل), desert highways.
  • Simulation depth: tire grip, weight transfer, drift suspension, turbo tuning.
  • Visible consequence: dynamic deformation — dent, crumple, smash (تتعفط، تنصدم، وتتكسر).
  • Fluidity (سلاسة): zero-lag even with damage sim on mobile.

Modes

  • Hajwala Free Drift: score chains for angle, speed, proximity, "نطل" transitions.
  • Highway Cruise (خطوط طويلة): infinite desert highway, slipstream, Khabaat jumps.
  • Ta'tees Traffic Attack: dense city AI traffic weaving without crashing.
  • Mataar Arena: coned airport tracks, tandem battles, online leaderboards.

2. Target Audience الجمهور المستهدف

Primary: MENA mobile (13–30)

Hajwala & highway fans in KSA / Gulf. Play on phone/tablet, short sessions, show-off culture, Arabic-first UI with English dev terms.

Secondary: sim-drift fans (PC)

Mid-range PC players who want realistic vehicle dynamics without iRacing complexity. Controller + touch + tilt.

Creators

Clip-worthy crashes, deformation close-ups, livery + plate customization for TikTok/YouTube Shorts.

Rating target: E10+ / PEGI 7 with stylized (non-gory) crash deformation. Full Arabic + English localization, Hijri event calendar, Saudi plates & regions (الرياض، جدة، الدمام).

3. Core Gameplay Loop

  1. Cruise / Drift → chain drift score + near-miss bonuses on highway or arena.
  2. Earn Rials + Rep → clean lines raise multiplier; crashes bank half but deform the car.
  3. Tune in Garage (تعديل وتزويد) → spend on visual (شكل) & mechanical (تزويد) upgrades.
  4. Show & Compete → Mataar tandem, time attack, photo mode; climb seasonal ladder.

Session length: 3–7 min runs. Retention hooks: daily "خط" (highway challenge), weekly drift conditions (heat → less grip), garage collection completion.

5. Deep Customization — Garage نظام تعديل عميق

Visual — شكل

  • Body kits: bumpers, skirts, spoilers, wide-body; LOD-swapped meshes.
  • Paint: metallic / matte / pearlescent + custom hex; dirt & scratch layers.
  • Window tinting (تظليل): 0–90% realistic transmission shader, legal-limit warnings.
  • Plates: Saudi format, region + letters/numbers, Arabic font, frame styles.
  • Rims (جنوط): diameter/width/offset, camber preview, 40+ licensed-style designs.
  • Suspension height (تهبيط / ترفيع): slider with fender-gap + scrub-radius readout.

Mechanical — تزويد

  • Engine: ECU stages 1–4, forged internals, redline +500–2000 rpm.
  • Forced induction: turbo / supercharger with boost curve, lag, BOV sound, intercooler.
  • Brakes: pads → big-brake kits; bias slider for drift initiation.
  • Drift suspension: coilovers, angle kits (+60° lock), welded-diff option, tire compounds (street / semi / drift).
  • Damage-aware tuning: roll-cage reduces deformation 30% but +40 kg.

6. Physics & Dynamic Deformation Damage فيزياء وواقعية

Vehicle dynamics

  • Tire model: simplified Pacejka + thermal grip falloff; front/rear split; handbrake locks rear.
  • Weight transfer: longitudinal/lateral load, body roll, suspension travel visualized.
  • Drift mechanics (تفحيط ونطل): clutch-kick, feint, brake-drift, "نطل" weight-flick bonus when switching lock mid-slide.
  • Surface: asphalt / sand bleed / painted runway markings with per-zone friction.
  • Assists: arcade → sim slider; gyro steering on mobile.

Deformation system (تتعفط، تنصدم، وتتكسر)

  • Impact solver: velocity + angle → per-panel dent depth, crumple zones fold, glass cracks, bumpers detach.
  • Visual: vertex-displacement + normal recompute, scratch/dent maps; doors/hood jam when crushed.
  • Mechanical: radiator leak, alignment pull, power loss after hard front hits.
  • Perf-safe: damage on low-poly "crash proxy" mesh, baked back to render mesh at 10 Hz.

7. Maps & Environment مابات وخطوط طويلة

A. Infinite Desert Highway (خطوط طويلة مفتوحة)

Chunk-streamed 2×3-lane highway, dunes, fuel stations, Khabaat (خبات) crests for jumps. Day/night heat-haze, sand gusts. Top-speed + slipstream events.

B. City + AI Traffic (تطعيس بين السيارات)

Riyadh-inspired grid: KAFD-style towers, roundabouts, souq alleys. 40+ AI traffic cars with lane-change AI for near-miss threading.

C. Mataar Arena (مطار)

Abandoned airport: runway drag strip, coned gymkhana, tandem drift circuit. Spectator stands, tire walls, skid-mark persistence.

8. Visual Style

Stylized-realism: PBR cars with clearcoat, baked desert GI + real-time sun, heat shimmer, volumetric dust behind sliding tires. Arabic signage, neon garage, Saudi-plate typography. Photo mode with aperture + shutter-speed motion blur. Touch UI: big thumb sliders for تهبيط/ترفيع, one-tap تظليل presets.

9. Performance Optimization — Smooth & Fluid أداء سلس وبدون لاق

Zero-lag strategy

  • Object pooling: traffic, particles, debris, skid quads — zero per-frame alloc.
  • LOD management: 3 car LODs + interior cull; traffic beyond 150 m = impostor boxes.
  • Efficient shaders: 1 uber-car shader, half-precision on mobile, tints via uniform not texture swap.
  • Damage throttling: deformation at 10 Hz, normals on damage events only.
  • Streaming: highway chunks recycled; textures ASTC/ETC2; audio OGG.

Budgets (mid-range phone)

  • ≤ 120 draw calls, ≤ 250k tris visible, ≤ 60 MB texture memory.
  • Physics fixed 60 Hz, render 30/60 adaptive; dynamic resolution 0.7–1.0×.
  • Cold start < 6 s, run restart < 1 s, hitch-free chunk swaps.
  • Quality presets: Battery / Balanced / Beast + auto-tuner.

GDD Sign-off

Scope: vertical slice = 3 cars (Camry كوامري, Cadenza كادينزا, Sunny صني) + 1 highway chunk + Mataar arena + Garage v1. Next: multiplayer tandem + police-chase "مطاردة" mode.

Single-file static build. No backend required. Touch + keyboard + gamepad. 3D via Three.js-ready asset slots (GLB).
